generated.details: High on the far-right wall, geometric sound-diffusion blocks form a connected natural-wood panel of square-ended blocks projecting to varied depths.
At the mid-plane right-hand tabletop end, the partly filled clear-glass water carafe has a broad flat base, rounded body, narrow neck and open pouring lip.
Beside it to the right, the stone paperweight is a palm-sized solid oval with a flattened underside resting on the wood.
At far left beside the table, the plain charcoal-metal coat stand has a vertical post, short upward hooks and a stable weighted base on the floor.
